Once three snowballs have been completed and stacked, you can decorate your snowman. There are dozens of different 3D items, which you can attach to your snowman.  When you are satisfied with your creation, you can take a snapshot of your work, save it in your photo album, then send it to your friends.  Use swipe to move the snowball; pinch and swipe to control the camera, taps and swipes to navigate through pages of decorations.

Art and game design by Miguel.  Programming by George. Music by Carey James.
